title: Mucosal and cellular immune measures predicted SARS-CoV-2 reinfection
summary: Across two community cohorts followed for a median 10 months, 1,156 participants had 128 observed reinfections. An interpretable XGBoost model identified nasal spike-specific IgA and spike-specific CD4+ central-memory T cells as informative predictors of subsequent reinfection. Predictive associations do not establish that the immune measures causally prevent reinfection or imply clinical benefit; the reviewed evidence does not establish testing of a frozen model before new outcomes.
organization: Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital; Nanjing University; Nanjing Normal University; Nanjing Medical University; Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications
